newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - RAKVERE Q1 TURNOVER UP 20 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - RAKVERE Q1 TURNOVER UP 20 PCT.

text.p: Rakvere meat company turnover was 137 million kroons in the first quarter, which is up 20 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the company said on Monday.
Production rose by 12 percent, it added in a statement.
"In spite of rapid growth in raw material prices and tough competition, Rakvere has done better than previously planned," Peeter Maspanov, the chairman, said.
The free trade agreement on agricultural products between Baltic states, in force since January 1, made it possible to start exporting to Latvia, the company added.
Rakvere has earlier said it will open its sales point in Riga in early May.
Rakvere estimates its turnover to grow to 667 million kroons and profit to 12 million kroons in 1997.
